content.text:
[Security audit - https://free.example]
Score: 74/100 (C)
Findings: 1 medium, 1 low (2 total) - 6 passing checks

Context:
- Audit coverage for: Free.
- Additional included checks require ownership verification: http-methods, exposure, api-exposure.

findings.title: DMARC record is missing
findings.evidence: No _dmarc TXT record was found for free.example.
findings.impact: Receivers cannot verify that mail claiming to come from the domain is authorized.
findings.remediation: Publish a _dmarc TXT record starting with p=none and a reporting address, then tighten the policy.

findings.title: TLS certificate expires in 9 days
findings.evidence:
Affected location: https://free.example/
Certificate notAfter is 9 days away.
findings.impact: An expired certificate blocks visitors with browser errors.
findings.remediation: Renew the certificate or enable automatic renewal.
